Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual fits exactly three more items of the same size, extending the two-item band tried before. This aims to keep residuals reusable for identical items, but the band may be rarer than the two-item version and the base Best Fit term may dominate.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= 3 * item and r - item < 4 * item else 0) for r in bins]
```
